label: B2B web portal requests
purpose: Requests made through the GlobalTravelEngine B2B web portal (the agency website): volumes, results returned, response times, response sizes and outcomes. Every request in the cube is channel WEB; XML/API traffic is in Statistics Zone and Statistics History Client.
grain: Web requests aggregated per request day and hour, customer, request type, product type, availability type, outcome, response-time band, destination/origin zone and travel date.
use_for: B2B web portal traffic: logins, searches, product details, bookings made on the website
web response times and slow web requests
web outcomes: correct, no results, errors, failed logins
web traffic by customer, market, product type or hour
not_for: API requests and look-to-book (Statistics History Client)

coverage.note: Daily from 2025-10-17 up to today so far (UAE time). Only channel WEB has data (about 1.5 million requests a year).

dates.label: Request date
dates.meaning: Day the web request was made, UAE time (the cube's main date).

dates.label: Request date (CET)
dates.meaning: The same request date in Central European Time (the engine's server time); differs from the UAE date only around midnight. Use only when CET is asked for.

dates.label: Travel date
dates.meaning: Service/check-in date the user searched or booked for.

measures.name: [AVG Response Time Sec]
measures.label: Web average response time
measures.definition: Average time the engine took to answer a web portal request, in seconds.
measures.notes: The cube's own format shows no decimals; typical value is about 4 s.

measures.name: [AVG Results]
measures.label: Results per web request
measures.definition: Average results returned per web request ([Results] / [Requests]).

measures.name: [AVG Size Bytes Response]
measures.label: Web average response size (bytes)
measures.definition: Average response size per web request in bytes.
measures.hidden_reason: duplicate of [AVG Size Kb Response] in bytes

measures.name: [AVG Size Kb Response]
measures.label: Web average response size
measures.definition: Average response size per web request in KB (bytes / 1024).

measures.name: [Filter Results]
measures.label: Web filtered results
measures.definition: Results left after the engine's filters (most likely what the user was shown); never more than [Results].
measures.notes: Not documented; equals [Results] for 'More Availability Options' requests. See review.

measures.name: [Requests]
measures.label: Web requests
measures.definition: Number of requests made through the B2B web portal: logins, availability searches (live and cached), more options, product details, cancellation policies, shopping basket and bookings.

measures.name: [Results]
measures.label: Web results returned
measures.definition: Number of results (product options) returned to web requests.

measures.name: [Size Bytes Response]
measures.label: Web response data (bytes)
measures.definition: Total size of web responses in bytes.
measures.hidden_reason: duplicate of [Size Gb Response] in bytes

measures.name: [Size Gb Response]
measures.label: Web response data volume
measures.definition: Total size of web responses in GB (binary: bytes / 1024^3).

measures.name: [Size Kb Response]
measures.label: Web response data (KB)
measures.definition: Total size of web responses in KB.
measures.hidden_reason: duplicate of [Size Gb Response] in KB

measures.name: [Size Mb Response]
measures.label: Web response data (MB)
measures.definition: Total size of web responses in MB.
measures.hidden_reason: duplicate of [Size Gb Response] in MB

named_filters.meaning: Web requests that ended in an error (the error values that occur in the data).

named_filters.name: web searches
named_filters.meaning: Availability searches on the web portal, live and cached.

named_filters.name: web booking requests
named_filters.meaning: Booking requests made on the web portal.

named_filters.name: slow web requests
named_filters.meaning: Web requests that took more than 10 seconds.

rules: This cube is B2B web portal traffic only (all channel WEB). Never add its [Requests] to Statistics Zone searches or Statistics History Client API requests.
[AVG Results], [AVG Response Time Sec] and [AVG Size Kb Response] are averages: ask the cube at the level needed; never sum or average them across rows.
[Size Gb Response] is binary GB (bytes / 1024^3); the bytes/KB/MB size measures are hidden duplicates.
Show response times with 2 decimals (the cube's own format rounds them to whole seconds).
Use 'Hours'[Hour] and 'Calendar'[Date] (UAE time); 'Hours CET'[Hour] and 'Calendar CET' are the same traffic in CET, only when CET is asked for.
Use the cube's measures only; never SUM a column.

review.question: What does [Filter Results] mean: results left after the engine's filters (what the user is shown), or results removed by the filters?
review.why: It is always at most [Results] and equals it for 'More Availability Options' requests, which fits 'kept' rather than 'removed'. The cube does not document it, so it stays low confidence until confirmed.
